candidate_sentence_map.S1: Nordic Fibreboard AS increased consolidated revenue in Q1 2026 by 7.3% to €1.861 million, compared with €1.735 million in Q1 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The growth was generated almost entirely by fibreboard sales and was supported particularly by Finnish DIY stores, where order volume increased by €241 thousand to €855 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Sales to the European Union rose to €1.781 million from €1.639 million, while sales to Africa declined to €62 thousand from €87 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Despite the revenue increase, profitability deteriorated substantially.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: EBITDA declined to a negative €395 thousand from negative €85 thousand, reducing the EBITDA margin to negative 21% from negative 5%.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The Group reported a gross loss of €105 thousand, compared with a gross profit of €127 thousand a year earlier, as cost of goods sold increased to €1.966 million from €1.608 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Electricity, heat and water costs rose to €1.048 million from €725 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The operating loss widened to €530 thousand from €217 thousand, and the net loss increased to €570 thousand from €228 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The net margin consequently declined to negative 31% from negative 13%.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Results were negatively affected by the scheduled factory shutdown in early January during the transition to the new boiler house.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Commissioning, calibration and start-up of the new system took approximately two months.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Cold weather also increased energy consumption, while gas prices nearly doubled in late February following the US military attack on Iran.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Although gas prices subsequently declined, they remained approximately 50% above the beginning-of-year level at the time of the report.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Distribution costs increased to €261 thousand from €228 thousand and administrative expenses to €154 thousand from €111 thousand, partly offsetting lower labour costs of €411 thousand versus €471 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Financial costs fell to €41 thousand from €51 thousand, but the prior-year period included €40 thousand of finance income from the sale of Trigon Property Development shares.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Cash flow improved operationally, with net cash generated from operating activities of €13 thousand compared with an outflow of €528 thousand in Q1 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: However, €169 thousand was invested mainly in production assets, while the prior-year period included a €539 thousand inflow from the sale of financial assets.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Financing activities generated €152 thousand, including a €343 thousand related-party loan.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Net cash decreased by €4 thousand, leaving cash of €1 thousand at quarter-end.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: At 31 March 2026, total assets were €9.694 million and liabilities €5.802 million, while equity fell to €3.892 million from €4.462 million at year-end 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Total borrowings increased to €3.320 million from €3.168 million, and the debt-to-equity ratio rose to 60% from 52%.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: Management expects fibreboard demand and sales volumes to remain stable, while focusing on Nordic market growth, new customers and interior finishing panels.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The Group also continued development of the Admirali Quarter and signed a preliminary agreement to sell ten Pärnu properties, with completion expected no later than 30 June 2026.

evaluation.label: Yes
evaluation.justification: All key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S1 (revenue growth), S4-S5 (EBITDA and net loss), and S8-S9 (net margin). K2 is covered by S20 (assets, liabilities, equity). K3 is covered by S10 (shutdown), S11 (duration), and S12 (gas price impact). K4 is covered by S1-S3 (revenue breakdown) and S5 (EBITDA). K5 is covered by S23 (Admirali agreement timeline). K6 is covered by S16-S19 (cash flow details). K7 is covered by S10 and S11 (boiler house upgrade). K8 is covered by S14 (personnel and labor costs). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.
